filter_note.note: Wednesday of Week 8 (TNF CAR@GB tomorrow). Loudest by count: BUF, DAL, IND, CHI, KC, NYJ, CLE, SEA, PHI, NE. Dropped mostly cross-club duplicates (Native American logo meme, Hornets legacy debate, Ravens collapse, Simmons/Baun trade talk), college football (Iowa State/Oregon Halloween unis, Indiana DrenchGang, Arkansas-Missouri, Deion, Texas Tech booster, Tulane, Mensah, Missouri RB, Tennessee recruit, Brian Kelly, UCLA, Big Sky), other sports (Cardinals 2011 and Red Sox 2004 baseball anniversaries, World Series Brewers-Rays, Knicks, Pelicans, Nuggets, Thunder, Flyers/Panthers/Jets/Ducks NHL, Lady Vols, LSU hoops, Aston Martin), memes and stunts (Protect the Penix, Chiefs Bin Laden meme, Chiefs gambling-ad backlash, Bills birthday cake, Humphrey dinner post, MCR cheerleader outfits, mascot map, Herbstreit fundraiser, Blank AOC donation), Rivalries uniforms (Lions, Jaguars, Titans), fan trade hypotheticals (Jayden Daniels, Caleb-for-Lamar, McBride to DEN, Pickens-Worthy, Rattler, Daniel Jones rumor), nostalgia (Daniels Hail Mary 2-yr, Hanford Dixon, Kordell Stewart doc, Colts 2018 draft), and items last updated before the 24h window (Eagles-Commanders primetime flex, Agar Week 7 recap, Giants OT win). HOU and TB had no club-room story in the 24h pull.
